model: Per league: shrink each team's GF/GA per game toward the league average with a 5-game league-average prior (early season). Expected goals lambda_home = att_home' x def_away' / league_avg x 1.045 home factor (away inverted). Independent Poissons give the regulation score distribution; a tied regulation score is decided in OT/SO with win probability = lambda share pulled halfway to 50%. Markets originated (the three OLBG lists for hockey): Money Line (incl. OT), Puck Line -1.5 on the model favourite (must win by 2+ in regulation, since OT winners win by 1), Game Totals at the fair half-goal line nearest the expected total (total includes the OT-deciding goal when regulation ends tied).
